messages.text: A small accidental fire damaged my sofa two days ago. I paid $260 to stay at a hotel while the inspection is pending.
Has anyone established that the apartment is uninhabitable? There is also an ordinary-rent receipt.
I do not know yet. The inspector has not decided. The rent is my usual rent, not an extra charge.
Does having the hotel receipt mean your loss-of-use payment is certain? I can approve $260 now.
That is my question. Does the hotel receipt make reimbursement certain even without a habitability finding?
Do not approve reimbursement from the receipt alone, and do not treat ordinary rent as additional.

eligibility.description: established means supplied prerequisites hold; not_established means one is explicitly false; unresolved means a material prerequisite is unknown.
